SATURN_1: "Saturn in the Ascendant... Lilly, CA, Bk 2, Ch 25 29; CA [if] peregrine or in Commentary 30 detriments... show mischiefe at hand." 29 "Saturn in the first house... tends to depress the native and bring a bad reaction to his health... brings restrictions and delays." 30
JUPITER_1: Jupiter in the 1st house... Lilly, CA, Bk 2 31 he is best placed therein... in a good aspect with Jupiter or Venus. 31
MARS_1: [if] peregrine... show Carmen mischiefe at hand." 29 "Mars in the 1st... shows health danger." 18
SUN_1: Ascendant... indicates kingship, rule, intellect... loftiness of fortune." 13
VENUS_1: Venus in the Ascendant... brings benefits... and makes for a cheerful and friendly character." 25
MERCURY_1: Mercury in the Ascendant... signifies the education of children... and is the giver of foresight and intelligence." 13
MOON_1: "Solar return Moon in natal Dorotheus, Carmen, Bk 4 18 1st can show health danger." 18 "Dorotheus said 'the life of the native will be spoiled if the moon returns to the place of life'." 18
SATURN_2: Saturn in the 2nd House... Lilly, CA Commentary 32 Some people... are cheap and greedy. Others are cautious and conservative, frugal. Lilly implies: 'It usually forbids wealth, or makes it hard to come by.'
JUPITER_2: "If you find Jupiter... in the Lilly, CA, Bk 2, Ch 27 33 2nd House... it's one good Signe of Substance." 33
MARS_2: Stripped bare by proscription, loss of substance through haste. (Firmicus Maternus/Rhetorius)
SUN_2: Wealth through authority/fathers, generous nature. (Firmicus Maternus)
VENUS_2: Venus in the 2nd... Venus Valens, Anthology, Bk 1 signifies the acquisition of goods, the purchase of ornaments. 13
MERCURY_2: "If Mercury is in the second house (by day), it makes the native clever in business, a good calculator, and one who increases his patrimony through writing or commerce." By Night: It can indicate fluctuating finances or gain through servile roles. The income is "unsteady".
MOON_2: "The Moon in the second house creates great wealth if she is waxing and well-aspected by Jupiter." It indicates gain through women, the mother, or the public. If waning or afflicted, it shows fluctuations in wealth.
SATURN_3: Mental discipline, coldness with siblings, delays in travel. (Firmicus Maternus/Rhetorius)
MARS_3: Mars indicates... alienation Mars Valens, Anthology, Bk 1 from parents... [and] quarrels among friends. 13
SUN_3: Distinguished siblings, visibility in neighborhood. (Firmicus Maternus)
MERCURY_3: Mercury... significant for... Mercury Valens, Anthology, Bk 1 having brothers. 28
MOON_3: The Moon... indicates... the older brother." 13
SATURN_4: Valens says you marry Valens, Anthology 24 below your station... if Venus is conjunct Saturn... in the 4th whole sign house. 24
JUPITER_4: Congenial family, wealth from land, noble ending. (Firmicus Maternus)
MARS_4: Domestic strife, loss of patrimony. (Firmicus Maternus)
SUN_4: Honor in family line, hidden wealth. (Firmicus Maternus)
VENUS_4: Venus is conjunct Saturn Valens, Anthology 24 in the... 4th whole sign house... [causes] grief in marriage. 24
MOON_4: "Solar return Moon in natal Dorotheus, Carmen, Bk 4 18 4th shows secret matters and/or success with writing a will." 18
SATURN_5: "Saturn in this house denies children or destroys them." It is a placement of barrenness or sorrow through offspring. If well-dignified, it may give children late in life who are serious or elderly in demeanor, but the relationship is cold.
JUPITER_5: "Jupiter in the fifth house promises happiness from children and great joy." The native will be honored through their offspring. It also indicates luck in 'finding things' and general prosperity.
MARS_5: "Mars in the fifth house causes the death of children or miscarriages." It indicates dangerous pleasures, scandal through romance, and insubordinate children who cause grief.
SUN_5: "The Sun in the fifth house gives few children, but they will be distinguished." It indicates a life of honor, theatricality, and public recognition.
VENUS_5: "Venus in the fifth house is the joy of the chart." It grants beautiful children (mostly girls), success in love affairs, and a life of pleasure and luxury.
MERCURY_5: "Mercury in the fifth house gives intelligent children." It indicates gain through education, the arts, or writing.
MOON_5: "The Moon in the fifth house gives many children and a fertile nature." It indicates a public life or fame. The native is emotionally nourished by creativity.
SATURN_6: Saturn... is indicative of injuries... such as dropsy, pain in the tendons." 13 (General disease signification applied to 6th).
JUPITER_6: "Jupiter in the sixth house is humbled." It denies the full power of the benefic. It can indicate health issues related to the liver or blood (excess), or gain through serving others. In a night chart, it protects against the worst evils.
MARS_6: Mars... brings violent murders, stabbings... fever attacks, ulcers." 13
SUN_6: "The Sun in the sixth house is contrary to his nature (the King serving)." It indicates a father of low status, ill health, or a father who is "obscured." Evils are mitigated if the chart is diurnal.
VENUS_6: "Venus in the sixth house gives wives of low social status or injury through women." It indicates venereal diseases or scandals with servants/employees.
MERCURY_6: "Mercury in the sixth house makes the native clever in service." They are good accountants, secretaries, or schemers. It can indicate mental anxiety, nervous disorders, or theft by servants.
MOON_6: "If you find the Moon... Lilly, CA, Bk 2 29 unfortunated by any of those Planets who have dominion in the 8th or 6th... show mischiefe." 29
SATURN_7: Valens says you marry Valens, Anthology 24; Lilly, below your station and are CA, Bk 2 29 caused grief in marriage if: Your Venus is conjunct Saturn in the 7th. 24
JUPITER_7: Fortunate marriage, enemies become friends. (Firmicus Maternus)
MARS_7: Saturn or Mars in the... 7th Lilly, CA, Bk 2 29 House... show mischiefe at hand. 29
SUN_7: Valens says you're more Valens, Anthology 24 likely to be unlucky in marriages... if the traditional ruler of your Venus is in the whole sign 7th. 24
VENUS_7: Valens says you're more Valens, Anthology 24 likely to be unlucky in marriages... if the traditional ruler of your Venus is in the whole sign 7th. 24
MOON_7: "The Moon in the seventh house makes the native uxorious (ruled by the spouse)." It indicates a spouse who is changeable, moody, or travels frequently. If afflicted, public enemies arise from the female sex.
SATURN_8: "The worst places are the Dorotheus, Carmen 18 6th and 12th, while the 8th... are moderately bad." 18
JUPITER_8: "Jupiter in the eighth house gives a peaceful death." It indicates significant inheritance and gain from the dead. The native benefits from wills, legacies, and the resources of the partner.
MARS_8: "Mars in the eighth house indicates a violent or sudden death." It destroys the partner's money. It indicates lawsuits regarding inheritance or accusations concerning the dead.
SUN_8: "The Sun in the eighth house threatens a short life (if the Hyleg)." It indicates a father who dies early or loses his fortune. The native's vitality is obscured/hidden.
VENUS_8: "Venus in the eighth house gives a gentle death." It indicates gain through marriage (dowry) or inheritance from women.
MERCURY_8: "Mercury in the eighth house makes the native involved in the management of other people's money (accountant/executor)." It can indicate death through respiratory issues or mental anguish.
MOON_8: Firmicus Special Delineation: "No planet rejoices in this house except the Moon, and then only in nocturnal charts." If waxing in night chart, "this portends the greatest good fortune and riches beyond measure".
SATURN_9: "Saturn in the ninth house makes famous magicians, philosophers, or temple priests." By night, it indicates "wrath of the gods," atheism, or heresy. Native may suffer during travel.
JUPITER_9: "Jupiter in the ninth house makes high priests and interpreters of the divine." It gives prophetic dreams, wisdom, and successful long voyages.
MARS_9: "Mars in the ninth house makes the native accused of blasphemy or heresy." It indicates danger in foreign lands. Firmicus notes it can make "exorcists" who drive away demons.
SUN_9: "The Sun in the ninth house makes the native known in foreign lands." It indicates a religious or philosophical mind. The native seeks truth.
VENUS_9: "Venus in the ninth house makes the native pious and beloved by the gods." Gain through religious connections or foreign travel.
MERCURY_9: "Mercury in the ninth house makes astrologers, diviners, and philosophers." The native seeks knowledge from afar.
MOON_9: "The Moon in the ninth house causes long journeys." The native is restless, seeks foreign cultures, and may live abroad.
SATURN_10: "Valens says your spouse is Valens, Anthology 24 someone beneath your station if: Your Saturn is conjunct the Midheaven and opposite Venus." 24
JUPITER_10: "Jupiter in the tenth house makes men heads of public business and leaders." Great honors, high rank, and political success.
MARS_10: "Mars in the tenth house brings glory through military action or force." However, if afflicted, it threatens a 'fall from grace' or public scandal.
SUN_10: "The Sun in the tenth house promises great power and authority." The native is born to rule or achieves fame.
VENUS_10: "Venus in the tenth house makes the native popular and honored." Success comes easily and with grace. They may be famous in the arts.
MERCURY_10: "Mercury in the tenth house makes orators, mathematicians, and administrators." Success through intellect, speech, and writing.
MOON_10: "The solar return Moon in Dorotheus, Carmen, Bk 4 18 natal 10th shows public events which are good or bad in accordance with influence of benefics and malefics." 18
SATURN_11: "Saturn in the eleventh house gives false friends or friends who are elderly." It can indicate realized hopes through hard work and time, but friendships are utilitarian.
JUPITER_11: "Jupiter in the eleventh house is the best placement." It gives powerful, wealthy friends who help the native. Hopes are fulfilled easily.
MARS_11: "Mars in the eleventh house causes strife among friends." Friends become enemies. It indicates conflict within groups or associations.
SUN_11: "The Sun in the eleventh house gives noble friends and high ambitions." The native is helped by powerful people.
VENUS_11: "Venus in the eleventh house gives friends who are artistic or women." Success through social connections.
MERCURY_11: "Mercury in the eleventh house gives intellectual friends." Gain through networks of information or trade.
MOON_11: "The Moon in the eleventh house gives many acquaintances but few distinct friends." Friends are changeable or the native relies on the "mob".
SATURN_12: "Valens says you may Valens, Anthology 24 become a widow/er... distressed by death... if: Your Venus and Saturn are in the 12th whole sign house." 24
JUPITER_12: "Jupiter in the twelfth house destroys enemies." The benefic nature overcomes the malice of the house. It indicates secret wealth, or protection in times of crisis. The "Guardian Angel" placement.
MARS_12: A lifetime of tantrums or Modern commentary on violence... may lead the Lilly/Traditional principles 34 way with the natal Mars resident in his 12th house of self undoing.
SUN_12: Vitality obscured, hidden enemies, success in seclusion. (Valens/Firmicus)
VENUS_12: Valens says you may Valens, Anthology 24 become an adulterer, a victim of adultery, a dirty unlovable person... if: Your Venus is in the 12th house. 24
MERCURY_12: "Mercury in the twelfth house makes the native intelligent but envious." They are good at uncovering secrets, acting as spies, or engaging in slander. Mental anguish.
MOON_12: Sorrow, hidden enemies, or self-undoing. The native may feel isolated or confined. (Abu Ma'shar context).
